item.title: Mostly Wobbling, Booking and Amazon Hold Steady — 2026-06-07
item.description: Eight positions sit in the portfolio on 2026-06-07, and the picture is mixed. Conviction is strongest at the top, where Booking holds its place as the steadiest bet on the list and PayPal sits in territory the standing rules treat as cheap. The middle of the lineup is calmer than the headlines suggest: two broad world funds, then Berkshire, then the S&P 500 fund. Of the eight, only Booking and Amazon are still described on disk as bets that are working; the other five read as wobbling, and one — the S&P 500 fund — has had its premium quietly priced away. The full order, with prices and a one-sentence read on each, sits in The Lineup; the sharper observations sit in What Stands Out.

item.title: Mostly Wobbling, Only Booking Holds Steady — 2026-06-06
item.description: Eight holdings sit on the desk this morning, and seven of them carry the same verdict: the bet is wobbling. Only Booking still reads as a bet that works. Conviction sits at the top with PayPal — the standing rules now treat the share price as a buying opportunity, and the forward read on holding it from here is the most positive of the lot. Conviction trails at the bottom with Amazon, where the forward read has turned meaningfully negative. The closest wobble worth a careful read sits in the middle of the lineup at SP500, where the share price has drifted to the trim line. See The Lineup for the full pass.
